unit: PF opt-in Timoshenko straight members (model_settings.shear_model = timoshenko_annulus_energy_v1) and their Euler-Bernoulli twins
status: frozen independent reference before any product comparison; not yet refuted by the second TASK; not product output, not a qualification or acceptance claim
independence: generators/pf_reference.py imports, reads and runs no product code; expected values are this generator's exact arithmetic, never product observations

numeric_representation.exact: authoritative; Q(pi) text forms 'p', 'p/q', 'r*pi', 'r/pi', '(n0 + n1*pi + ...)/(d0 + d1*pi + ...)', 'sqrt(...)' for a norm outside Q(pi), 'a + sqrt(b)/(c)' for a maximum
numeric_representation.decimal: 40 significant digits from the exact form (pi by Machin, 140-digit context)
numeric_representation.expected: binary64 rounding of the exact value converted into the row unit; never a product value
numeric_representation.inputs: decimal inputs are exact rationals (r_i = 9/100 m, and so on); the requests author the nearest binary64 values (relative effects of order 1e-16). E = 200e9 Pa and G = 77e9 Pa are exact binary64 integers, so nu = E/(2G) - 1 = 23/77 is exact for the authored values; the phi = 2 cases author dyadic OD, wall and L, exact in binary64

criteria.negative: for every discriminator row: |observed - wrong| > 1e-9 max(|observed|, |wrong|); every listed wrong value is separated from the expected value by more than 1e-7 relative
criteria.no_new_threshold: the existing 1e-9 relative criterion only (t4_u8's policy)

row_conventions.key: (kind, entity_ref, component, location); basis_ref is the load case, or for a combination {ref_type: combination, ref_id}
row_conventions.end_rows: element_local force rows at end_i/end_j: node-on-element end actions, element-local DOF sense
row_conventions.station_rows: quarter_1/midspan/quarter_3: the section-cut action on the +x face of the i-side segment
row_conventions.stress: element_local stress rows (MPa) at all five locations from the +x-face section action: axial N/A, bending M_y/Z and M_z/Z, torsional T r_o/J, on PF's single section
row_conventions.maximum: pipe_elastic_normal_stress_maximum_v2 (Pa, governing_station): max over the member of |N/A| + hypot(M_y, M_z)/Z, frozen only where the five-station maximum is provably the member maximum
row_conventions.displacements: global, mm; rotations global, rad: on a Timoshenko member the section rotation theta, not the slope
row_conventions.reactions: support_reaction_component_v2: support-on-pipe, global, R = K u - f; a spring's reaction is -k u in its DOF; a nonlinear support's slot carries its constraint force when engaged, the applied friction force when sliding and zero when released; magnitudes are the force and moment norms
row_conventions.discriminating: on every row of both twins: true where the Timoshenko and Euler-Bernoulli expectations lie more than 1e-7 relative apart (a zero against a nonzero counts); authored_nu_discriminating likewise against the authored-nu solve (PFT-AUTHNU)
row_conventions.not_frozen: element_global_end_force_v1, element_global_end_moment_v1, element_local_normal_stress_extreme, element_local_transverse_shear_stress_maximum, displacement_magnitude and linear_solver_mode_basis rows, whose formulas are not stated in a design read here; for combinations also the magnitude and maximum rows

zero_scale_definitions.scale_force: max |expected| over this load case's nonzero force rows (N)
zero_scale_definitions.scale_moment: max |expected| over this load case's nonzero moment rows (N*m)
zero_scale_definitions.scale_length: max |expected| over this load case's nonzero displacement rows (m)
zero_scale_definitions.scale_rotation: max |expected| over this load case's nonzero rotation rows (rad)
zero_scale_definitions.scale_stress: max |expected| over this load case's nonzero stress rows (Pa)
zero_scale_definitions.fallback: a family with no nonzero row takes a neighbouring family's scale: force = moment / Lmax, moment = force * Lmax, length = rotation * Lmax, rotation = length / Lmax (Lmax the longest member)

controls.euler_bernoulli_twins: each EULER-BERNOULLI case is the Euler-Bernoulli expectation of its TIMOSHENKO twin's document without model_settings.shear_model; an EXPLICIT-EULER-BERNOULLI case has the same rows
controls.breach: a Timoshenko product judged against the Euler-Bernoulli twin's rows must breach on every row marked discriminating; on PFT-AUTHNU a product judged against the authored-nu rows must breach on every row marked authored_nu_discriminating

discriminator_catalogue.euler_bernoulli_despite_timoshenko: the selection ignored: every member Euler-Bernoulli. Its values are the Euler-Bernoulli twin's expected rows, so it is not listed again; the rows it moves are those marked discriminating
discriminator_catalogue.timoshenko_despite_euler_bernoulli: shear added to an Euler-Bernoulli document: its values are the Timoshenko twin's expected rows (the discriminating marks on the twin)
discriminator_catalogue.cowper_factor: Cowper's annular factor 6(1+nu)(1+m^2)^2/[(7+6nu)(1+m^2)^2+(20+12nu)m^2] in place of kappa_E
discriminator_catalogue.kappa_on_nominal_wall: kappa_E and A_s on the nominal wall t (r_i = OD/2 - t) while A, I, J use t - c_m
discriminator_catalogue.stiffness_on_nominal_wall: the whole section, kappa_E included, on the nominal wall t (mill tolerance ignored)
discriminator_catalogue.authored_nu_for_kappa: kappa_E from the authored poisson_ratio instead of E/(2G) - 1
discriminator_catalogue.swapped_plane_signs: the x-z plane placed with the x-y plane's signs (theta = +ry)
discriminator_catalogue.kappa_on_GJ: kappa applied to the torsional stiffness GJ
discriminator_catalogue.shear_area_in_EA: A_s in place of A in the axial stiffness
discriminator_catalogue.theta_equals_slope: published rotations replaced by the centreline slope v' = theta + V/Ks at free member ends
discriminator_catalogue.euler_bernoulli_recovery: member end actions recovered with the Euler-Bernoulli K from the Timoshenko displacements (reactions from R = K u - f with the Timoshenko K are unaffected)
discriminator_catalogue.shear_stiffness_unscaled: a W-15 body's shear stiffness kappa G A left unscaled while E and G are scaled by s
